reason: Both CIFs parse and primitive-standardize as symmetry-inequivalent P21/m (No. 11) Ti2Ni2 cells with Z=2, four fully occupied sites, the stated 2.73976 x 4.26410 x 4.69024 A, beta=94.95761 deg cell, and chemically plausible complete neighbor shells (minimum periodic distances 2.531 and 2.477 A). Exact recovery is nevertheless not established. The primitive cell leaves reproducible important reflections unexplained, including isolated lines at 40.27, 41.09, 53.03, 69.16, and 82.98 deg at roughly 6-15 times the measured baseline noise, plus the 42.17 deg feature. The trace obtains Rwp=16.61% versus a 14.61% Pawley-like bound only after adding 18 independently fitted nuisance peaks, so this is a flexible composite profile fit rather than an atomic CIF accounting for the full pattern; its RMS residual (0.971) is also about 9.5 times the reported noise (0.102). The trace itself indexed larger monoclinic cells, including a fourfold B19-related cell that places some of these extra lines and an extended cell indexing the first 30 picked lines, but instantiated and refined no corresponding stoichiometric atomic model and did not quantitatively reject symmetry lowering or a superstructure. Another attempt should resolve all significant lines and test an explicit larger-cell/lower-symmetry realization before the submitted primitive models can be accepted as exact.
